question: If DOG is coded as 420 and COW is coded as 1035, then how will CAT be coded as
solution:
The place value alphabets A to Z are shown below;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/130e026a7c3720f6f9db70163ea219cbcf01f13f419b49f6b5b6c1ad7f909510.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Multiply the alphabet's position value code as a number.**

DOG is coded as 420

D(4) + O(15) + G(7) → 4 × 15 × 7 → 420

COW is coded as 1035

C(3) + O(15) + W(23) → 3 × 15 × 23 → 1035

Similarly, CAT is coded as;

C(3) + A(1) + T (20) → 3 × 1 × 20 → 60

**Therefore, CAT is coded as 60**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
